long_biography.plain_text:
On Antalya's Aspendos Boulevard, Rıdvan Güzel is directing Luviya, a mixed urban development built around homes, offices, a hotel and a shopping centre. The project marks the scale of his move into property after decades of delivering climate systems for hotels, airports, hospitals and public buildings. He has also expanded into urban-renewal schemes and Accor-branded hotels.

Güzel's business approach includes local institutional commitments. RGüzel has funded school buildings and hospital facilities, including medical equipment donated in his parents' names, and supported both Antalyaspor and Alanyaspor. He also served as an Antalyaspor vice-president. The group owns solar projects in Ermenek and Mut, while Can Kardeşler continues to deliver large Mitsubishi Electric installations.
